'''Endor''' is the 20th expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher in 1999 and consists of 198 cards.

This was the first of two sets to focus on the latter two-thirds of ''Return of the Jedi''. It included a vast number of characters and vehicles that were designed to be useful in battles. CardGuide lists 198 cards (180 expansion plus 18 foils on some checklists).
